 Before

 Order
Date : 16.11.2023 Heard Mr. P. K. Deka, learned counsel for the petitioner.

Also heard Mr. B. Sarma,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

This application under Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 has been filed by the petitioner, namely, Smti Anjana Rani Das who is Page No.# 2/3 apprehending her arrest in connection with Silchar P.S. Case No. 1432/2023 under Sections 498A/302 of the Indian Penal Code.

The gist of accusation in this case is that on 02.08.2023, one Rajat Kanti Deb had lodged an FIR before the In-Charge of Rangirkhari T.O.P. under Silchar Police Station, inter alia, alleging that the Anjana Rani Das vs The State Of Assam on 16 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/66271392/
1 daughter of the first informant who was married to the accused No. 1 named in the FIR was brutally tortured by the accused persons named in the FIR including the present petitioner and later on she was killed by the accused persons.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the present petitioner is the mother-in-law of the deceased and there was a matrimonial dispute between the husband and the wife after which the deceased had consumed poison as a result of which she died.

sentences.text:
It is also submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that, in the meanwhile, the accused No. 1, namely, Debojit Das, who is the son of the present petitioner was arrested and, later on, granted bail by this Court in Bail Application No.
3590/2023.
It is also submitted that the accused No. 3 named in the FIR has also been granted bail by the learned Additional Sessions Judge (FTC), Cachar, Silchar.
It is further submitted by learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is looking after two minor sons of the deceased and she is ready to cooperate in the investigation.

On the other hand, learned Additional Public Prosecutor has submitted that the bail prayer for the present petitioner was rejected by the Court of Sessions Judge after perusal of the case diary finding sufficient incriminating materials against the present petitioner and on that ground he opposes prayer for bail of the present petitioner.
Page No.# 3/3
It is also submitted by learned Additional Public Prosecutor that considering the nature of allegations made in the FIR, perusal of the case diary would be necessary.
Hence, call for the case diary, fixing 07.12.2023 for case diary.

However, in the meanwhile, as the present petitioner is a women of 58 years of age and also considering the fact that other two named accused in the FIR are already on bail, she is hereby directed to appear before the Investigating Officer of Silchar P.S. Case No. 1432/2023 within a period of ten days from the date of this order and cooperate in the investigation.

If she does so,
within the stipulated period of time, in the event of her arrest in connection with Silchar P.S. Case No. 1432/2023, the petitioner shall be allowed to go on interim bail of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand) with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of arresting authority with a condition that the petitioner shall cooperate with the Investigating Officer in the investigation.
List this matter again on 07.12.2023 for case diary.
